items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: On guitar we picked up a young man, named Floyd Smith.

ctx.x: He opened in '35 with us, but then he -- he left, he had a better job offered him and he left. And, we sent and got Joe Jones. Joe Jones in Sidney's place. Joe Jones worked with us a very fine drummer, you could play shows, he was flashy. But everybody loved Sidney. Especially show people, we all loved him.

On guitar we picked up a young man, named Floyd Smith. Floyd Smith. Floyd was a little young genius. On the guitar, could play in all keys. He could improvise -- he could play harmonics on the guitar, he was just -- just a genius. Floyd stayed with us until 1938. And, in the meantime, the band opened up in 1935, and they opened up with -- was that Ziggy Johnson?
